title: Kozma's centrally excited walk converges to a Euclidean ball
status: Working mathematical draft. Internal mathematical reviews completed; external Opus 5.5 xhigh writing revision in progress. Not a formal proof certificate or external peer review.

length.comparison_caveat: All five original figures and explanatory material are restored. Whole-document page count is not the measure of proof simplification.

simplifications: Convex second differences telescope along lattice lines, replacing smooth approximation in the cell estimate.
The exit bootstrap obtains a deterministic stopped clock bound before estimating martingale probabilities.
The exponential of distance to the convex body replaces direction choices and direction nets in the crossing estimate.
Dynkin applied to the square of the Green function controls local variance directly; no convolution or resolvent estimate is needed.
Backward radial integration replaces the entire Euclidean curvature bootstrap.
One covariance identity controls polynomial and Green martingales, including adaptive first-departure laws.
Fluctuation lower bounds use only coarse filled shape; fixed-site centering uses no sharp outer-radius estimate.
The Sobolev inequality uses the rank bound twice, improving its error constant and covering every convex gauge.
strengthenings: Adaptive first-cookie laws constrained only by their means.
Codimension-one weighted drift defects, including all Nguyen excitation parameters.
Almost-sure filled shape and uniform local-time profile for Nguyen model.
Moment CLT and signed LIL for every convex gauge.
Finite-scale calibration and uniform bounds on small occupation layers.
All-scale boundary cap volumes and depth-dependent boundary local times.
Occupation bound C(t+h_n) r_n^(d-1) in place of C(t+delta_n) r_n^(d-1).
Bulk oscillation lower bounds for every convex gauge, also in every fixed polynomially growing window.
Joint vector/moment Gaussian limit and a product bound for simultaneous planar radius confinement.
Sharp anisotropic Sobolev inequality for every convex gauge, with a smaller Euclidean error coefficient than Nguyen Appendix A.
limits: No claim of improved Euclidean outer-radius exponents.
Deterministic cone centering for fixed-site CLT/LIL is proved only in the Euclidean case.
Prescribed-path logarithmic lower bounds require uniform ellipticity.
No claim of optimal proof length or external verification.

principal_result_correspondence.scope: Prescribed-mean radial cookies; almost-sure filled shape, uniform local times, recurrence.
All theta in (0,1], with kappa=theta/d and lambda(x)=d/m(x). Filled almost-sure shape and uniform cone imply Hausdorff, measure and L2 conclusions.
Part (i): all Euclidean radius, volume and uniform-local-time bounds, with original exponents.
Parts (iii)-(iv): both planar radial polynomial tails and LIL constants, bulk maximum, and width polynomial tail, LIL and small-ball bound.
All norm and convex-gauge qualitative conclusions.
Sum and moment-radius CLT and signed LIL; generalized to every convex body with weighted statistic.
Joint fixed-site CLT and signed LIL with original constants; additional potential-centered version for every convex body.
Full logarithmic radius tails and eventual almost-sure consequences, with explicit uniform ellipticity.
Independent-interest appendix inequality: generalized to all convex gauges; smaller remainder coefficient; sharp anisotropic form.
